snippet.title: Rainbow Six Mobile - Global Launch Date Reveal
snippet.description:
🚨 Operators, the wait for Global Launch is nearly over!

✨ After years of dedication, ongoing improvements, and the incredible support of our amazing community, global launch is just around the corner!

📅 Mark your calendars: February 23, 2026. 

Rally your squad. Gear up. Global launch is coming.

👉 More details here: https://rainbowsixmobile.com/global_launch

Register now: http://www.rainbowsixmobile.com
Join the community: https://discord.com/invite/Rainbow6Mobile
Twitter: http://twitter.com/rainbow6mobile
Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/rainbow6mobile
